name: Fix async mentions build in project store
description:
Here is a 5-line summary of the conversation:

1. The code refactors a Vue/Vuex store module (`project.js`) to handle asynchronous mention searching across projects.
2. Two helper functions, `ensureKnowledgeLoaded` and `ensureProfilesLoaded`, were added to lazily load project data before building mention lists.
3. The `buildMentions` function was made `async` and now relies on the caller to ensure data is pre-loaded before execution.
4. The `searchMentions` method on `$state` was made fully `async`, loading knowledge and profiles for the current project and all related projects in parallel before searching.
5. A new `searchMentions` Vuex action was added as a clean entry point for components to trigger async mention searches via `$storex.projects.searchMentions({ query, limit })`.

messages.content:
Fix how we build mentions.
Loaiding knowledge is async so we can't use a getter to get a project mentions we must wait for all the projects to have loaded their knowledge, then build the mentions.
Fix searchMentions to work with the async scenario we have
